title: Deployment Record
description: Terminal artifact produced by the Deployment Orchestrator (Stage 7) at the close of a pipeline run. Records the paths of all deployment deliverables, the deployment status, and the gate-7 sign-off. Consumed by git-workflow-manager in completionMode and by the archive-manager.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact (e.g., '1.0').

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the target project as configured in This Project.

deploymentDate.description: ISO 8601 date on which the deployment record was produced (e.g., 2026-05-11).

pipelineConfigPath.description: Relative path to the CI/CD pipeline configuration document produced by ci-cd-engineer.

environmentsConfigPath.description: Relative path to the environment configuration document produced by environment-configurator.

releasePlanPath.description: Relative path to the release plan document produced by release-coordinator.

monitoringConfigPath.description: Relative path to the monitoring configuration document produced by monitoring-configurator.

healthCheckPath.description: Relative path to the health check validation document produced by health-check-validator.

rollbackPlanPath.description: Relative path to the rollback procedures document produced by rollback-planner.

deploymentStatus.description: Gate-7 readiness status. Must be 'ready-for-deployment' for Gate 7 to pass.

blockingReason.description: Required when deploymentStatus is 'blocked'. Describes why deployment is blocked and which specialist must resolve it.

ticketKey.description: Optional TicketKey of the pipeline run that produced this record (e.g., TT-42). Present only in namespaced-run mode.
